concept.title: Scenes and Sources
concept.shortdesc: StreamForge Capture's simplified scene and source model.

conbody.p: StreamForge Capture deliberately supports only three source types—Webcam, Microphone, and Screen—compared to OBS Studio's eleven. There are no filters and no scripting; sources are added, resized, and arranged, and that's the whole model.

Capture also supports only one scene at a time rather than a saved collection of scenes, since its target use case is a single always-the-same webcam layout rather than switching between multiple setups.
